layers.Effect1: A small ring forms at the feet, then becomes a broad multi-line ground circle and upward radial flare as the arms open.
layers.Effect2: Loose concentric particle spirals surround preparation; a field of upward energy spikes appears around the arm-open phase.

layers.Effect4: Broader bright contour/afterimage follows the moving body and limbs.
layers.Effect5: Tighter, finer patterned body contour follows the action with less surrounding spread.
